from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql = '''WITH genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100, 0) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    INNER JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
        ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN Track AS t
        ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    INNER JOIN Genre AS g
        ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        i.BillingCountry,
        t.GenreId,
        g.Name
),
ranked_genres AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked_genres
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY
    country ASC,
    country_rank ASC;
'''
path=Path('/work/query.sql')
path.write_text(sql)

con=sqlite3.connect('file:/inputs/Chinook.sqlite?mode=ro', uri=True)
count=[0]
def progress():
    count[0]+=100
    if count[0] > 2_000_000:
        return 1
    return 0
con.set_progress_handler(progress,100)
cur=con.execute(path.read_text())
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('rows', len(rows), 'approx_vm_steps', count[0])
print('description', [(d[0]) for d in cur.description])
print('first', rows[:8])
print('last', rows[-4:])
print('types(first)', [type(x).__name__ for x in rows[0]] if rows else 'no rows')
print('sql_bytes', len(path.read_bytes()))
# Make sure file is exactly one executable statement (tail after first semicolon is whitespace).
text=path.read_text()
print('complete_statement', sqlite3.complete_statement(text), 'semicolons', text.count(';'))
con.close()
